why: The 3MTLs are a course-specific implementation of multimedia instruction, combining narrated speech, visual slides, and video in a coordinated sequence; their review purpose and short duration do not constitute a distinct general element.

claims.verifier: The claim directly concerns learning outcomes associated with podcast-supplemented multimedia instruction.

rejected.verifier: The evidence concerns students’ perceived uses of short videos or podcasts, not the design or effectiveness of coordinated multimedia instruction itself.
